title: Maps from finitely presented algebras into essentially smooth algebras factor through smooth algebras
statement: Let $R\to D$ be an essentially smooth homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-essentially-smooth-ring-map], $C$ an $R$-algebra of finite presentation ($C\cong R[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_m)$) and $g:C\to D$ a homomorphism of $R$-algebras. Then there are a smooth $R$-algebra $T$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map] and homomorphisms of $R$-algebras $C\to T\to D$ whose composite is $g$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma Tag 07FJ, justification of item (item-eighth-resolve), lines 3062-3074: 'D' is essentially smooth over the local Artinian ring ... Hence D'[t_1,...,t_d] is a filtered colimit of smooth algebras and B (x) ... factors through one of these'; written out as a statement by an agent (D = S^{-1}P is the filtered colimit of the smooth R-algebras P_s, s in S, and a finitely presented algebra map into a filtered colimit factors through a stage)
